purpose: Redirect the legacy release host vcskill.vchun.dev to the canonical ariadnev.com, path-preserving, without redeploying the frozen legacy Worker that still holds the hostname via a Workers Custom Domain.
rationale: ariadnev@1.0.0 installers and update-command.ts hardcode https://ariadnev.com. The legacy host must keep answering for stale bookmarks and piped-bash callers, but it must land on the canonical host. A zone-level Single Redirect achieves that additively: applying and removing it is a one-rule API call with no deploy, which is what keeps the first-cutover rollback instant.
lifetime: Outlives workers/bridge. The bridge is deleted at the Phase 12 candidate-b cutover; this rule persists and its status_code flips 302 -> 301 only after the rollback window closes.
statusCodeRationale: 302, not 301, for the whole rollback window. A 301 caches indefinitely in browsers and intermediaries and cannot be recalled, which would partially defeat a rollback to vcskill.vchun.dev. curl does not cache redirects, so machine clients are indifferent either way.

rule.description: ariadnev: redirect legacy host to ariadnev.com

corpusNote: Verified against the rule's own expression by verifyPolicy() in scripts/manage-legacy-host-redirect.mjs, which gates --apply. Host and path are both declared because the corpus must be able to catch a scoping mistake (eq -> contains) that no path-only list could see.
